title: A Hint of Halloween Quiz Night on Wednesday 7 October
preheader: £3 cash entry, teams of up to six and a few spooky touches. Reserve online, pay on the night.

data.heading: Quiz Night, with a hint of Halloween
body: Round up your team for our regular Quiz Night, with a few spooky touches creeping into the questions. Expect general knowledge, music, TV and film, plus one round in the middle that you play on your phone. No horror expertise needed.
Reserve online, pay on the night. Entry costs £3 per person, payable in cash when you arrive. No online payment is taken.

image.alt: A Hint of Halloween Quiz Night at The Anchor in Stanwell Moor

rows.label: Seating
rows.value: Book your team in together and we will seat you together

data.heading: A few things to know
body: First prize is a £25 bar voucher, valid on food or drink for one month. Second-to-last place wins a bottle of wine.
First-time teams are welcome. Come early for dinner, served from 4pm to 9pm, and order before the first question.

data.body: Book everyone in your team together, then agree on a suitably spooky team name.

data.reason_for_contact: You are receiving this because you have booked with us before, or because you said you would like to hear from us. That may have been a while ago now, and we are glad you are still with us.
